framing.lineOfInquiry: Gaurav Yadav (P00312) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE017
framing.alternate: Gaurav Yadav (P00312) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: Someone else used the phone or handset
alternateHypotheses.statement: Some records attributed to Gaurav Yadav were generated by another person using the same phone or handset.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate
